result: Adam combines momentum with per-coordinate scaling: it keeps moving averages of g and g², corrects their bias towards zero, and steps α·m̂/(√v̂ + ε). The step is invariant to gradient scale and roughly bounded by α, which makes α easy to set.
result_plain: Bias-corrected moving averages of g and g²; step α m̂/√v̂, scale-invariant and bounded by about α.
